title: Payment Gateway Timeout - Checkout Failures
description: Payment gateway intermittently timing out on the checkout flow since 14:00 AEST. Approximately 15% of transactions are failing. Affected systems: Payment Service API, Order Management Service. Customer impact: orders not completing, revenue loss ongoing. Error: Connection timeout after 30s on POST /api/payments/process. SRE team alerted and monitoring.
